data.title: LASK vs Liverpool Preview: Team news, lineups & prediction
data.content:
Ben Gray

Liverpool beat LASK home and away in the Europa League three years ago, 3-1 in Linz and 4-0 on Merseyside, meaning the Reds have won eight of ten previous clashes with Austrian clubs. LASK have never beaten a Premier League outfit in six attempts, losing five, all coming since 2020.

So, ahead of Liverpool's visit to Raiffeisen Arena on Wednesday evening, check out our preview, predictions, team news and TV info.

LASK vs Liverpool match info

Date: Wednesday 14 October 2026. [...] Predicted Line-ups

LASK predicted lineup: Jungwirth; Andrade, Mbuyamba, Alemão; Jørgensen, Bogarde, Ljubičić, Horvath, Bello; Lang, Adeniran.

Liverpool predicted lineup: Alisson; Araújo, Jacquet, van Dijk, Tsimikas; Gravenberch, Mac Allister, Wirtz; Muñoz, Ngumoha, Barcola.

Score prediction: LASK 1-3 Liverpool.

NewsFootball NewsPremier League News

LASK vs Liverpool Preview: Team news, lineups & prediction

#### Football [...] So, what changes could Andoni Iraola make? Kostas Tsimikas may well be rotated in for Miloš Kerkez at left-back while, on the opposite side, he seemingly does not trust Jeremie Frimpong. Rio Ngumoha is poised to come into attack, after Lewis Koumas led the line at the weekend, while Bradley Barcola is seeking his first goal for the club. Lastly, Ryan Gravenberch will be suspended at Brentford on Saturday, so is certainly set to start this one.

## Out-of-form teams meet in Austria

Both LASK Linz and Liverpool desperately need a win to turn their seasons around. What will happen when the sides meet in Wednesday's early kickoff?

### Hosts have lost three from four [...] Andoni Iraola is expected to name Alisson Becker in goal for Liverpool, with Virgil van Dijk and Ronald Araujo forming the central defensive partnership. The projected XI features Florian Wirtz and Alexis Mac Allister in midfield, with Bradley Barcola and Lewis Koumas supporting the attack. No injuries or suspensions have been reported for the away side at this stage.
